pages.text: Nuclear power is the strongest energy in CyberFarm, and the most demanding. A $(l)Fission Reactor$() shaped like a cooling tower burns uranium $(l)Fuel Rods$(). Its core boils water into $(l)Steam$(), and $(l)Steam Turbines$() turn the steam into FE, just like a real power

$(li)Mine $(l:nuclear/uranium)uranium$(/l) deep underground and craft $(l:nuclear/fuel_rod)Fuel Rods$(/l).$(br)$(li)Build the $(l:nuclear/fission_reactor)Fission Reactor$(/l) tower.$(br)$(li)Feed it $(l)water$() with $(l:basics/water_pump)Water Pumps$(/l) and $(l:cables/liquid_pipe)Liquid Pipes$(/l).$(br)$(li)Send the steam to $(l:nuclear/steam_turbine)Steam Turbines$(/l), and their FE into $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduits$(/l).
pages.title: The power plant

pages.text: $(li)To run the reactor harder, cool it with $(l:nuclear/coolant)Coolant$(/l) from a $(l:nuclear/coolant_mixer)Coolant Mixer$(/l).$(br)The $(l:nuclear/fission_reactor)Fission Reactor$(/l) page has a table of what each tower size produces, and how many turbines it needs.

A reactor keeps burning as long as its power is on, $(l)whether or not it is cooled$(). If it makes more heat than it can move out, the core gets hotter. At $(l)80%$() an alarm sounds; at $(l)100%$() the core $(l)melts down$() and explodes. Watch the temperature bar, and turn the power down (or off) when something goes wrong.
pages.title: Safety first

pages.text: Spent rods are $(l)nuclear waste$(): left untreated they make the area $(l:nuclear/radiation)radioactive$(/l). Treat them in a $(l:nuclear/waste_reprocessor)Waste Reprocessor$(/l). Wear a $(l:nuclear/hazmat_suit)Hazmat Suit$(/l) and carry a $(l:nuclear/geiger_counter)Geiger Counter$(/l) when things go wrong.
